tasks.corrected_reference_answer: Visitor creates FNMatcher wrappers only for string fil/rec arguments during initialization. tasks.corrected_reference_answer: TestAccesses creates its Source once in setup_class and reuses it across its test methods (testing/code/test_source.py:76-94). Initializing a string Source splits and deindents the text (src/_pytest/_code/source.py:22-34). Moving this to module/class scope would shift the work to import and could reuse it during repeated sessions in the same still-loaded process, but would not persist it across separate process runs. The source supplies no timing evidence for an appreciable improvement; the existing class setup already avoids per-method construction.

tasks.corrected_reference_answer: The premise is contradicted by test_plugin_prevent_register: after blocking abc, direct register(42, name="abc") leaves the plugin set unchanged (testing/test_pluginmanager.py:442-448). PytestPluginManager.register delegates to super().register and runs its added hooks only for a non-None result (src/_pytest/config/__init__.py:492-515). Assertions verify policy enforcement; they do not implement it. Any additional policy should be centralized at the registration boundary while retaining tests of blocked registration and avoiding duplication of inherited enforcement.

tasks.notes: Read the question/reference and relevant pinned-source code; static review only, no repository code executed.
tasks.corrected_reference_answer: The test demonstrates package-scoped autouse and explicitly requested fixture visibility using two tests, not a scaling benchmark (testing/python/fixtures.py:1874-1915). FixtureDef.execute resolves dependencies and checks its cache, returning an existing result on a cache hit before setup or new finalizer scheduling (src/_pytest/fixtures.py:1074-1134). finish executes registered finalizers and clears the cache (lines1053-1072). More distinct scopes/parameters can require more lifecycle work, but package scope avoids per-test instantiation; the source does not establish a bottleneck at hundreds of fixtures.

material_errors: Wrong reflected method: string > path uses path.__lt__, not path.__gt__.
tasks.notes: Read the question/reference and relevant pinned-source code; static review only, no repository code executed.
tasks.corrected_reference_answer: LocalPath is in src/_pytest/_py/path.py. Its __fspath__ returns strpath (lines553-554); __lt__ and __gt__ compare os.fspath(self) with os.fspath(other) (lines579-583). Strings therefore compare with string-backed LocalPath objects through the filesystem-path protocol. Reflected comparisons reverse the operator: when a string’s implementation returns NotImplemented, string > path falls back to path.__lt__(string), and string < path to path.__gt__(string).

checked_claims.reason: eval receives populated globals, does not automatically import merely importable modules.

material_errors: Says mere module importability is sufficient for an unbound name in expression.
tasks.notes: Read the question/reference and relevant pinned-source code; static review only, no repository code executed.
tasks.corrected_reference_answer: evaluate_condition supplies os, sys, platform and config, merges reversed pytest_markeval_namespace hook mappings, then overlays the test function’s module globals before compiling/evaluating a string (src/_pytest/skipping.py:98-118). Thus os.sep is available by default unless overwritten. Other names must be bound in those namespaces (or explicitly imported within the expression); mere importability of a module does not bind its name. A collected item/config and valid expression are required, and evaluation errors are reported as failures.
